Where is The Courtyard Stories located in Delhi?
+

We are at Farm No. 3, The Courtyard Stories, behind FIMT College, Kapashera, Palam Farms, New Delhi 110037 (see Google Maps). The estate is about 15–20 minutes from Dwarka Sector 21 Metro (Blue Line), with secure on-site parking for up to 25 production vehicles and vanity vans.
